response.sql:
WITH long_rental_films AS (
  SELECT rating, rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0) AS rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration >= 5
), rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rate_per_day) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM long_rental_films
  GROUP BY rating
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_avg
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT ra.rating,
       ra.avg_rate_per_day,
       ra.film_count,
       ra.avg_rate_per_day / b.overall_avg AS relative_to_benchmark
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
WHERE b.overall_avg IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: “5 days as the cutoff” means including films with rental_duration of 5 days or more. SQL AVG ignores NULL rate-per-day values, and COUNT(*) counts all qualifying films in each rating.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff is intended to mean strictly longer than 5 days, exclude films with a 5-day rental duration.
